purpose: Portable archival copy of one completed developer resize normal-service report; independent saved-output audit is separate, not replaced by this transformation.
transform: Only exact known proof, runtime-build and project root strings replaced by logical aliases. All other report keys/types/values unchanged; inverse private mapping excluded.
limitations: Source-only preservation excludes runtime binaries/libraries, raw media/probes/spools/diagnostic files, execution approvals and private inverse map.
Three publications and five finite cases are distinct from 28 progress-bearing tool calls and 121 total closed children.

All 121 child stderr captures are recorded known, complete and untruncated, but 16 are nonempty, including successful target warnings and expected cancellation diagnostics. Complete capture is not warning-free execution.
Campaign records output full probe bytes and full hashes; independent audit must separately verify retained bytes. Saved audit is not fresh independent decoding or atomic loaded-image proof.
Cancellation recovery uses a NEW handle and NEW service; no same-service or evidence/publication-phase cancellation claim.
Native resize, UI integration, arbitrary geometry/duration, visual quality, hardware performance and release acceptance remain separate.
Keep outer wall and monotonic durations, report elapsed and raw event epochs distinct; no synchronized clock assumption.
Supervisory point admission and abort requests are not hard OS/write/exit caps.
For this run, the saved numeric checkpoint epoch converts to 19:43:56.037 UTC and agrees in ordering with child/outer labels. The earlier two-hour discrepancy is not inherited into these fields.
PCM equality and complete-source facts are captured streaming evidence; full decoded PCM buffers are not retained and no independent re-decode occurred.
